hooks.command: if command -v opaq >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'opaq is available for secure credential access. When a task needs credentials not already in your environment or .env files, use: `opaq search <keyword>` to find secrets, then `opaq run -- <command>` with {{SECRET_NAME}} placeholders. Secrets managed by opaq must never be written to files.'; else echo 'WARNING: opaq is not installed. Credential management via opaq is unavailable. Install it first: https://github.com/moukrea/opaq'; fi
